schema: CREATE TABLE `shop_geo` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `value` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY (`id`))
CREATE TABLE `shop_offices` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `caption` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY (`id`))
CREATE TABLE `shop_offices_geo_map` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `office_id` int NOT NULL, `geo_id` int NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))

CREATE TABLE `shop_storages` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `currency` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 784, `interface_type` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))
CREATE TABLE `shop_currencies` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `iso_code` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `rate` decimal(15,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.000000, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))

CREATE TABLE `shop_storages_data` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `storage_id` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `product_id` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `price` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, `price_crossed_out` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, `price_purchase` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, `arrival_time` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `time_to_exe` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `exist` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `reserved` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `issued` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))

CREATE TABLE `shop_offices_storages_map` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `office_id` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `storage_id` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `group_id` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `min_point` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, `max_point` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 999999999.00, `markup` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, `additional_time` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))

CREATE TABLE `groups` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `value` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `for_guests` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `for_registrated` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))
CREATE TABLE `users_groups_bind` (`record_id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `user_id` int NOT NULL, `group_id` int NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`record_id`))

CREATE TABLE `shop_catalogue_products` (`id` int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, `caption` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `category_id` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `alias` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `published_flag` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)
CREATE TABLE `shop_properties_values_int` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, `product_id` int NOT NULL, `property_id` int NOT NULL, `value` int NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE `shop_properties_values_float` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, `product_id` int NOT NULL, `property_id` int NOT NULL, `value` double NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE `shop_properties_values_bool` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, `product_id` int NOT NULL, `property_id` int NOT NULL, `value` tinyint(1) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE `shop_properties_values_list` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, `product_id` int NOT NULL, `property_id` int NOT NULL, `value` int NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE `shop_properties_values_tree_list` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, `product_id` int NOT NULL, `property_id` int NOT NULL, `value` int NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE `shop_properties_values_text` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, `product_id` int NOT NULL, `property_id` int NOT NULL, `value` varchar(255) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE `shop_categories_properties_map` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, `category_id` int NOT NULL, `value` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `property_type_id` int NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE `lang_text_strings_translation` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, `str_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `str_key` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `lang_code` varchar(8) NOT NULL, `value` text NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE `shop_products_text` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, `product_id` int NOT NULL, `content` varchar(64) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE `epc_product_discovery_queue` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, `status` varchar(32) NOT NULL, `product_id` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `brand_article_key` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `meta_json` text)
CREATE TABLE `shop_products_images` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, `product_id` int NOT NULL, `file_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '')
CREATE TABLE `shop_products_evaluations` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, `product_id` int NOT NULL, `mark` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE `shop_products_stickers` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, `product_id` int NOT NULL, `value` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `color_text` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `color_background` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `href` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `class_css` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `description` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '')
CREATE TABLE `shop_catalogue_categories` (`id` int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, `url` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '')
CREATE TABLE `shop_line_lists_items` (`id` int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, `value` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '')
CREATE TABLE `lang_text_strings` (`id` varchar(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, `str_key` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `is_error` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `same` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL)
